subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silently processing and retaining unmentioned speech changes privacy, cost, and security semantics rather than only fixing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit allowlist checks, retention/provenance bounds, docs, schema, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for a cross-channel policy
options.body: Keep this open as product input until media-history retention is designed consistently across Discord, Signal, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should never be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit allowlist checks, retention/provenance bounds, docs, schema, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the Discord preflight/config policy surface.
